name: kg-mcp
description: Cloud CGC MCP — Code Graph Context: infra knowledge, specs, docs, semantic code search

native_build._cmd_comment: git config --system safe.directory '*' FIRST: octocode keys each GraphRAG project by its git-root. The repos volume is owned by root but the MCP runs as appuser — without this, git fails 'dubious ownership', octocode can't resolve the git-root, and the reader lands on a DIFFERENT project key than the root-built index (symptom: 'GraphRAG knowledge graph is empty' despite a populated DB). --system writes /etc/gitconfig as root during the RUN (before the USER appuser switch) so EVERY runtime user resolves the same key.
native_build.cmd: git config --system --add safe.directory '*' && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs && npm install --omit=dev && pip3 install --break-system-packages --no-cache-dir pylance

db_publish._comment: Durability: the octocode GraphRAG index (FastEmbed vectors + LLM relationship graph, a multi-hour build) lives only in the octocode_db volume on `host`. ship-kg-db.yml (GHA) snapshots it to image:tag on GHCR so a volume wipe is restorable by pulling the image. GHA (not the local ship) so the package can be flipped PUBLIC. Consumed by 1_workflows/src/scripts/cloud-kg-db-snapshot.sh.

llm._comment: octocode GraphRAG LLM -> claude-api-superset (kg-bridge successor), TWO providers with fallback. openai:* reads OPENAI_API_URL -> superset /v1 (3117); ollama:* reads OLLAMA_API_URL -> superset Ollama mimic (10.0.0.6:11436 — the superset binds the WG IP, not localhost). reindex.sh forces use_llm=true and tries `models` in order, falling back if a provider makes 0 superset /health calls. api_key is a throwaway.

kg_store._comment: reindex.sh ingests the infra graph delta into kg-store (SurrealDB) after building the code graph — unified 'build all graphs' job. Localhost host-network; ns/db/user data-driven; delta from the cgc bundle. KG_STORE_PASS (SurrealDB root) is wired as a shared secret later; until then the ingest gracefully no-ops.
